title: test: load package barrels at module top so the collect phase pays for them
body:
Fixes #21457

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

Five test files, test-only. Every case that loaded a package barrel with a dynamic import inside its body now gets that barrel from a module-top load, so the load is charged to vitest's collect phase instead of the case's 5000ms window (AGENTS.md: 「Clocked windows measure behaviour, never loading」). The shape and the reasoning are the core precedent's, `packages/core/src/service-resolution-discriminator.contract.test.ts`; no helper was added. No timeout, retry, skip, `vitest.config.ts`, source or gate change.

| site (line numbers at `7e7e64b1`) | change |
|---|---|
| `packages/objectql/src/system-write-organization.test.ts:506` | `import * as barrel from './index.js'` at module top; the case is now synchronous and still asserts, by identity, that both names come from the barrel |
| `packages/core/src/security/platform-admin.test.ts:279` | `import * as securityEntry from './index.js'` at module top; the case still probes presence and absence on the security entry |
| `packages/lint/src/validate-predicate-path-refs.test.ts:376` | `import * as barrel from './index.js'` at module top |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/translations/serving-seam.test.ts:86` and `:100` | one static import plus one module-top re-evaluation under a mock, see below |
| `packages/lint/src/lazy-deps.test.ts:190` | the triage's named exception: keeps its in-case import, and one comment line now says why |

### The one site where the hoist was not mechanical: `serving-seam.test.ts`

Hoisting changed what this file observes, so it was not a plain move. The `:86` case evaluated the barrel against a MOVED source: a `beforeEach` ran `vi.resetModules()`, then the case ran `vi.doMock('./en.objects.generated.js', ...)` and imported the barrel. A static import cannot be mocked per case. The resolution keeps each assertion's meaning:

- `:100` ("substitutes nothing while the source has not moved") reads a static `import { SharingTranslations } from './index.js'`, which is the barrel as committed.
- `:86` ("SERVES the current source when the source moves under the recorded leaf") reads `servedAfterSourceMoved`. That value is produced at module top by the same four steps the `beforeEach` and the case used to perform: `vi.resetModules()`, `vi.doMock(...)`, `await import('./index.js')`, `vi.doUnmock(...)`. A top-level await in a test module runs during collection; the repo already uses that shape in `packages/cli/test/score-lint-crash.test.ts` and `packages/mcp/src/__tests__/plugin-execution-context.test.ts`.
- The `beforeEach` is removed. It existed only to isolate the two in-case imports, and no case imports anything now.

So one `await import('./index.js')` remains in that file, at column 0 at module top and not inside a case. The triage pin is about loads inside a case.

**Ablation** (one-time, on the committed tree, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode with its own restore proof): deleting the module-top `vi.resetModules();` turns exactly the `:86` case red, `AssertionError: expected 'Token' to be 'Share token'`, with 1 failed and 4 passed. Without the reset, the import returns the copy the static import cached. The restore was proven: blob `9d8e14d9fe22` equals HEAD's, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Measured

Every reading was taken on this container's shared box. Other agents' work ran alongside, and the verify lock excluded only other locked runs, so the absolute numbers are shared-box seconds. The signal is the per-case drop.

**Per-case duration, run alone** (one file plus `-t`, vitest JSON reporter; the number in brackets is the same case in a whole-file run):

| case | before (`7e7e64b1`) | after (`8e8b3bb6`) |
|---|---|---|
| objectql barrel case | 1669 ms (1556) | 2.4 ms (0.1) |
| core security-entry case | 1695 ms (1837) | 2.1 ms (0.1) |
| lint predicate barrel case | 57 ms (68) | 5.2 ms (0.4) |
| sharing `:86` | 107 ms (134) | 1.5 ms (0.3) |
| sharing `:100` | 114 ms (57) | 1.4 ms (0.2) |
| lint lazy-deps in-process case (the exception, unchanged) | 8372 ms | 8296 ms |

**In the package's whole suite.** CI's Test Core runs each of these four packages whole on its shard; only `@objectstack/cli` takes file-level slices. So the whole-suite run is their shard. The readings are on `2d2204d764`; for the before leg, the edited file(s) were restored tree-only from `7e7e64b1`.

| case | before | after | suite, both legs |
|---|---|---|---|
| objectql (`--project local`) | 614 ms | 0.1 ms | 366 files, 7383 tests passed |
| core (both projects) | 313 ms | 0.3 ms | 79 files, 2204 tests passed |
| lint predicate | 34 ms | 0.2 ms | 119 files, 5619 tests passed |
| lint lazy-deps (the exception) | 5476 ms | 5544 ms | same run |
| sharing `:86` / `:100` | 99 / 56 ms | 0.2 / 0.2 ms | 38 files, 954 tests passed |

The load did not disappear. It moved into the collect phase, which vitest 4's summary calls "import". For example, objectql's single-case run went from import 7.84s and tests 1.67s to import 10.02s and tests 4ms.

Nobody had measured the other five sites before this. At these readings, only the objectql and core cases carried a load large enough to matter (1.5 to 1.8 s alone). The lazy-deps case is not under the default window at all: it already runs under `COLD_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000`, and it measures 5.5 to 8.4 s.

## Verification

- `pnpm test` per package on `2d2204d764`: core 76 files / 2156 tests, lint 119 / 5619, plugin-sharing 38 / 954, all passed. objectql `vitest run --project local`, which is its `test` script: 366 / 7383 passed.
- `pnpm typecheck` for all four packages: exit 0, and `check:test-typecheck` OK in each. All five files are in their package's `tsconfig.test.json` program (`tsc --listFiles`), and none of them carries an error.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 63 commands from this tree, the same list as the PM's derivation. All 63 were run and all exit 0. `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3); after a turbo cache replay of their build closure, both re-ran green. The `--ran` reconciliation: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- ESLint, narrowed with the narrowing proven: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the five files on `2d2204d764` linted 5 files (none reported as ignored), with 0 errors and 0 warnings. `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no `projectService`), so this diff cannot change a verdict on any file it does not touch. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Pin grep, `git grep -n "await import('\./index" -- 'packages/**/*.test.ts' ':!packages/spec'`, gives 3 hits: the core precedent's own comment, `lazy-deps.test.ts:191` (the named exception) and `serving-seam.test.ts:84` (at module top). The spec side, as the control, gives 45 hits.
- `check:test-source-alias` does not flag this shape. Per the triage ruling, that is recorded here and the gate is not widened. It is green on this tree.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same family, other spellings.** These sites are outside this card's ruled pattern and outside its claimed files. Each is an in-case barrel load, measured alone on `2d2204d764`:
  - `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-compare-kind-refusal.test.ts:220`, `../index.js`: 568 ms;
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/send-template.test.ts:336` and `:342`, `./transports/index.js`: 37 ms and 1 ms;
  - `packages/metadata/src/loaders/overlay-index-single-producer.test.ts:150`, `../migrations/index.js`: 24 ms.

  None is near the window. They are noted here and not filed.
- **Base:** the branch was cut at `7e7e64b1` and merged with `origin/main` at `49524f6906`.
